test_points: Measure in order: X3_1-2, X3_2-4, X3_9-29, X2-5
meter_tests.normal_reading: 24V DC at each measured stop-circuit terminal.
meter_tests.normal_reading_zh: 每一个顺序量测点都应有 24V DC。
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning: The first terminal without 24V is the interrupted part of the stop circuit.
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning_zh: 第一个没有 24V 的端子，就是 stop circuit 的中断方向。
steps_zh: 确认门体周围安全，避免门突然动作。
万用表设为 DC V 直流电压档。
黑表笔固定在 X3_6-19（-24V）。
顺序很重要；第一个没有 24V 的位置就是需要继续检查的中断点。
排除该中断点后，如果 stop circuit 仍中断，再继续量测下一个端子。
safety_notes_zh: 带电量测只限合格技术人员操作。
不要用电表笔短接相邻端子。
steps_en: Make sure the door area is safe and the door cannot move unexpectedly.
Set the multimeter to DC voltage.
Keep the black probe on X3_6-19 (-24V).
Measure X3_1-2, X3_2-4, X3_9-29, and X2-5 in that order.
The sequence is important. The first point without 24V is the interrupted section.
After fixing that section, continue with the next terminal if the stop circuit is still interrupted.
safety_notes_en: Live electrical measurement must be performed only by qualified personnel.
Do not short adjacent terminals with the meter probes.

meter_tests.title_en: X13 final stop circuit resistance check
meter_tests.title_zh: X13 最后段 stop circuit 电阻 / 蜂鸣测试
meter_tests.meter_mode_zh: 电阻档 / 蜂鸣导通档
meter_tests.normal_reading_zh: 正常为 0 ohm 或蜂鸣导通。
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning: OL means the final stop circuit path is interrupted.
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning_zh: 显示 OL 表示 X13 相关 stop circuit 路径中断。
steps_zh: 完成前面的 24V stop circuit 顺序测试后，再做此测试。
将黑表笔移到 X13-5。
万用表切换到电阻档或蜂鸣导通档。
若显示 OL，检查 X13 encoder / motor cable / safety sequence wiring。
safety_notes_zh: 切换到电阻档前，应确认量测方式符合现场安全要求。
不要在不确定的带电回路上使用电阻档。
steps_en: Perform this test after the 24V stop-circuit sequence test.
Move the black probe to X13-5.
Set the multimeter to resistance or continuity mode.
Measure between X13-1 and X13-5.
If the meter shows OL, inspect the X13 encoder, motor cable, and safety sequence wiring.
safety_notes_en: Confirm the circuit is safe before using resistance or continuity mode.
Do not use resistance mode on an unknown live circuit.

meter_tests.normal_reading: Approximately 12V DC between X13-1 and X13-2A.
meter_tests.normal_reading_zh: X13-1 与 X13-2A 之间应有约 12V DC。
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning: No 12V can indicate encoder supply, wiring, or control-box supply fault.
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning_zh: 没有 12V 可能代表 encoder 电源、X13 接线或控制箱供应异常。
steps_zh: 检查 X13 接线：1 为 +12V，2A 为 GND。
万用表设为 DC V。
量测 X13-1 与 X13-2A 之间是否有约 12V DC。
若 D15 闪 1 次或 8 次，也应检查 X13 cabling 和 12V supply。
若 12V 正常但问题持续，检查 encoder / junction box / motor cable。
safety_notes_zh: 表笔不要碰到 RS485 A/B 或相邻端子造成短路。
steps_en: Check X13 wiring: terminal 1 is +12V and 2A is GND.
Set the multimeter to DC voltage.
Measure between X13-1 and X13-2A.
If D15 flashes 1x or 8x, also check X13 cabling and 12V supply.
If 12V is present but the fault remains, inspect the encoder, junction box, and motor cable.
safety_notes_en: Live electrical measurement must be performed only by qualified personnel.
Do not short adjacent terminals with the meter probes.

meter_tests.title_en: 24V external device supply test at X3_6
meter_tests.title_zh: X3_6 外部设备 24V 电源测试
meter_tests.normal_reading_zh: 应有 24V DC；外部负载最大 360mA。
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning: Missing or low 24V can indicate overload, short circuit, or supply protection.
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning_zh: 没有 24V 或电压偏低，可能是外部回路过载、短路或保护动作。
steps_zh: 万用表设为 DC V。
若 24V 异常，先断开外部 24V 负载后再复测。
逐一接回 photo cell、light curtain 等外部设备，找出造成过载或短路的支路。
如显示 12/24V circuit malfunction，优先检查所有 12V/24V 外部连接。
safety_notes_zh: 不要直接短接 X3_6-18 和 X3_6-19。
外部设备总负载不得超过 360mA。
steps_en: Set the multimeter to DC voltage.
Measure between X3_6-18 and X3_6-19.
If 24V is abnormal, disconnect external 24V loads and test again.
Reconnect photo cells, light curtains, and other external devices one by one.
Identify the branch causing overload or short circuit.
safety_notes_en: Live electrical measurement must be performed only by qualified personnel.
Do not short adjacent terminals with the meter probes.

meter_tests.title_en: Photocell 2 supply and signal check at X3_6
meter_tests.title_zh: X3_6 Photocell 2 电源与信号检查
meter_tests.normal_reading: Photocell 2 uses X3_6 20-22 and is active as standard in parameter 31.
meter_tests.normal_reading_zh: Photocell 2 接在 X3_6 20-22，并且 parameter 31 预设启用。
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning: Incorrect voltage or signal can indicate blocked photocell, wiring fault, missing bridge, or wrong parameter 31 setting.
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning_zh: 电源或信号异常可能代表 photocell 被遮挡、接线错误、bridge 被移除或 parameter 31 设置不符。
steps_zh: 确认 photocell 2 是否真的安装在 X3_6 20-22。
若未安装 photocell，确认 X3_6 20-22 的 factory bridge 是否存在。
检查 X3_6-19 为 -24V，20/21 为 +24V photocell supply。
检查 22 signal output 是否随 photocell 遮挡/放开而变化。
确认 parameter 31 与实际 photocell 配置一致。
safety_notes_zh: 测试 photocell 时不要站在门运行路径内。
steps_en: Confirm photo cell 2 is installed at X3_6 20-22.
If no photo cell is installed, confirm the factory bridge at X3_6 20-22.
Check X3_6-19 as -24V and X3_6-20/21 as +24V photo cell supply.
Check whether terminal 22 signal output changes when the beam is blocked and released.
Confirm parameter 31 matches the installed photo cell configuration.
safety_notes_en: Live electrical measurement must be performed only by qualified personnel.
Do not short adjacent terminals with the meter probes.

meter_tests.normal_reading: Photocell 1 is connected at X12 1-3 and is deactivated as standard unless enabled in parameter 31.
meter_tests.normal_reading_zh: Photocell 1 接在 X12 1-3；预设停用，需由 parameter 31 启用。
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning: A photocell 1 display with parameter 31 disabled usually points to wiring/configuration mismatch.
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning_zh: 若 parameter 31 未启用却出现 photocell 1 相关显示，通常要检查接线或设定是否不一致。
steps_zh: 确认现场是否安装 photocell 1。
检查 photocell 1 是否接在 X12 1-3。
确认 parameter 31 是否启用 photocell 1。
若作为 retraction security 使用，确认只通过 X12 连接。
测试遮挡/放开 photocell 时显示是否同步变化。
safety_notes_zh: 不要为了消除显示而长期旁路安全装置。
steps_en: Confirm whether photo cell 1 is installed.
Check that photo cell 1 is wired to X12 1-3.
Confirm parameter 31 enables photo cell 1.
If used as retraction security, confirm it is connected through X12.
Block and release the beam and confirm the display changes correctly.
safety_notes_en: Live electrical measurement must be performed only by qualified personnel.
Do not short adjacent terminals with the meter probes.

meter_tests.title_en: Safety edge wiring check at X3_7 / X3_8
meter_tests.title_zh: X3_7 / X3_8 Safety edge 接线检查
meter_tests.meter_mode_zh: 电阻档 / DC V，依 safety edge 类型选择
test_points: X3_8: OPTO safety edge, 25 +12V, 26 Signal, 27 GND
meter_tests.normal_reading: Reading depends on parameter 21 and installed safety edge type.
meter_tests.normal_reading_zh: 正常读值取决于 parameter 21 与实际 safety edge 类型。
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning: Mismatch between parameter 21 and wiring can trigger ERR or safety edge errors.
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning_zh: parameter 21 与实际接线/类型不一致，会造成 ERR 或 safety edge 错误。
steps_zh: 先确认安装的是 DW、8.2k、OPTO、wireless 或 light curtain。
确认 parameter 21 选择与实际 safety edge 类型一致。
DW / 8.2k 类型检查 X3_7 接线。
OPTO 类型检查 X3_8：25 +12V、26 signal、27 GND。
若 parameter 21 选择 OPTO 或 light curtain，确认 X3_7 23-24 没有不该存在的连接。
safety_notes_zh: Safety edge 是安全装置，不可为了测试长期旁路。
改 parameter 21 后必须做完整功能测试。
steps_en: Identify whether the installed device is DW, 8.2k, OPTO, wireless safety edge, or light curtain.
Confirm parameter 21 matches the installed safety edge type.
For DW or 8.2k, inspect X3_7 wiring.
For OPTO, inspect X3_8: 25 +12V, 26 signal, 27 GND.
If OPTO or light curtain is selected, confirm X3_7 23-24 has no incorrect connection.
safety_notes_en: Confirm the circuit is safe before using resistance or continuity mode.
Do not use resistance mode on an unknown live circuit.

meter_tests.title_zh: X20 stop circuit 电阻分析
meter_tests.normal_reading: Control box can use any value between 3k and 15k as the principle value; common examples include 3k, 4.5k, 5k, 6k, 8k, 11.2k.
meter_tests.normal_reading_zh: 控制箱可用 3k 到 15k 作为基准值；常见组合为 3k、4.5k、5k、6k、8k、11.2k。
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning: Lower than programmed value can indicate short circuit. No resistance can indicate short circuit in this resistance-analysis mode.
meter_tests.abnormal_meaning_zh: 量测值低于已学习/设定值可能代表短路；无电阻也可能被判定为短路。
steps_zh: 确认 stop circuit 使用的是 X20 idle current 还是 resistance analysis。
若使用 resistance analysis，确认 parameter 23:04。
检查 SCD1/SCD2/PD/permanent resistance 组合是否符合实际门叶设备。
如更改 X20 stop circuit，需重新学习/设定 resistance value。
若出现 SHOR 或 X20 short-circuiting，重点查找短路或错误电阻组合。
safety_notes_zh: 不要随意改变 X20 安全回路电阻组合。
完成后必须测试 pass-door / slack cable device。
steps_en: Confirm whether X20 uses idle-current analysis or resistance analysis.
If resistance analysis is used, confirm parameter 23:04.
Check whether the SCD, pass-door, and permanent resistance combination matches the actual door equipment.
If the X20 stop circuit was changed, reprogram the resistance value.
If SHOR or an X20 short-circuit error appears, inspect for short circuit or incorrect resistance combination.
safety_notes_en: Confirm the circuit is safe before using resistance or continuity mode.
Do not use resistance mode on an unknown live circuit.
